scope: Whole native atlas images actually opened by the root and compared to the existing crew-atlas artistic identity reference. This is a prototype cohesion review, before the separate actual-game inspection.

images.observed: Armure claire/rose et cheveux attachés ; geste action sans effet biotique incorporé.
Armure Alliance bleu-gris et cheveux courts ; armes dessinées génériques pouvant varier entre poses.
Armure bleue et silhouette turienne, quatre poses distinctes ; arme illustrée générique.
Armure rouge, tête et large silhouette krogan cohérentes avec le prototype existant.
Peau bleue/crêtes asari et tenue claire/bleue conservées dans les quatre dessins.
Capuche violette et combinaison intégrale ; aucun visage découvert.

limitations: No complete primary original-game costume/model comparison.
Four fixed key poses per character, no interpolated cycle or additional directions.
Weapons are generic drawings and can vary between poses; equipment identity and abilities are determined by the game logic.
Soft low-alpha colour fringes remain in native outputs; the renderer uses alphaTest0.2 and the pixel audit checks that visible silhouettes are not cut.
